reviewer: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5); one fresh-context medium correctness reviewer

claims.summary: For every N>=4 and nonzero entries, the total finite non-branch Weierstrass weight of the degree-two pair space is at most T_sep(N)=N(N-1)(N-2)(N-3)/4=2 lambda_N, and that of the one-double-root space at most T_conf(N)=(N-2)(N-3)(N^2-N-10)/4, with equality iff branch and infinity multiplicities are minimal; T_sep(N)=binom(N-2,2)+2(N-2)(N-3)+T_conf(N), the binary-face, neck and bubble counts.
claims.assessment: Working proof: local-exponent degree bounds as in the confluent criterion, and a polynomial identity in N verified symbolically.
claims.rationale: Necessary consistency check for reducing separated generic simplicity to the one-double-root class; the reduction itself needs minimal branch multiplicities, the bubble identification and squarefree slope-0 and slope-1 edges.

relationships: Local exponent formulas for the bubble.
